scenarios.known_bug: XP[clone-gain-this-trigger-lost]: After the turn-1 upkeep copy (Cryptoplasm -> Silvercoat Lion, GainThisAbility$ True) gorge poses NO upkeep trigger on turn 3: RunOracleScenarioJSON decisions list shows only attackers after setup, and snapshots at turn 3 upkeep/main have an empty stack, so the copy did not keep "this ability". The gained trigger is appended only when engine/effects/clone.go:484-489 finds the resolving SA inside a printed trigger's Effect chain by pointer identity (cloneChainContains, clone.go:649) and the fold appends of.Triggers[Amount-1] (engine/events/apply_copy.go:397-405); an index of -1 appends nothing -- most likely failure point (not single-stepped). CR 707.9b (copy 'except it has this ability'), Cryptoplasm Oracle. Translation side issue: the test has no actions, so all setChoice/addTarget are silently dropped by assignChoices (lab/cmd/xmageport/translate.go:229, to==nil) -- turn 3's Craw Wurm target would be lost even with a fixed engine (fallback picks first target, Silvercoat Lion).
